presets.name: context7
presets.description: Current, version-specific library documentation for coding tasks.
presets.warning: An optional Context7 API key increases limits and can access private sources configured in that account.

presets.name: github
presets.description: Repositories, issues, pull requests, reviews, and Actions context.
presets.warning: GitHub access follows the account and repositories approved during sign-in.

presets.name: sentry
presets.description: Investigate application errors, traces, releases, and project health.
presets.warning: Sentry can expose production error data. Scope the connection to only the organizations and projects needed.

presets.name: supabase
presets.description: Read-only database, schema, logs, and project development context.
presets.warning: The preset is project-scoped and read-only. Supabase recommends development or test projects rather than production data.

presets.name: openai-docs
presets.description: Official OpenAI developer documentation and API references.
presets.warning: This read-only server retrieves public OpenAI documentation.

presets.name: jira
presets.description: Issues, projects, pages and team work.
presets.warning: Your Atlassian permissions apply. An administrator may need to approve Locus.

presets.name: notion
presets.warning: Choose which workspace to connect. Tools can read and update shared pages.

presets.name: slack
presets.description: Channel conversations, search and team actions.
presets.warning: Requires a user token from an internal or Slack Marketplace app approved for MCP. Slack does not support automatic client registration.

presets.name: google-calendar
presets.description: Calendars, availability and events for every Locus agent.
presets.warning: Uses the bundled Locus adapter. Google sign-in must be configured for this build. Reads calendars and creates or changes events after approval.

presets.name: google-drive
presets.description: Find and read documents, spreadsheets and presentations.
presets.warning: Uses the bundled Locus adapter. Google sign-in must be configured for this build. Read-only file search and document content.
